children: InterDigital is boosting its quarterly dividend by 7.1%, to 75 cents a share, from 70 cents.
The new payout, equal to $3.00 a year, represents a 0.9% yield based on the company's Wednesday closing price of $339.34.
The dividend will be paid on Oct 28. to shareholders of record as of Oct. 14.
